Mixed purées

Pea, sweet potato, and fish

Zöldborsós édesburgonyás hal

6 months+ Sound idea 30 min 4 portions

Serve from six months. Smash the peas and check the fish for bones. This contains fish.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 80 g peas (fresh or frozen, to be smashed)
  • 200 g sweet potato (peeled weight)
  • 120 g skinless boneless cod or hake (fresh or plain frozen, not smoked)

Allergens

fish

Method

  1. Peel the sweet potato and cook it in unsalted water until soft.
  2. Add the peas and cook until they squash easily.
  3. Add the fish and cook until it is opaque and flakes.
  4. Remove every bone.
  5. Smash the peas and blend everything until smooth.
  6. Do not add salt.

Sound idea

Whole peas are a poor texture in a first purée. A label of 7 or 8 months is later than this dish needs.

Smash the peas and blend them with sweet potato and boneless white fish, after the bones are checked. Serve it from 6 months rather than from 7 or 8 months.
